catalysts.headline: Viking Therapeutics reported Q3 2026 results after market close: net loss widened to $183.2M (vs $90.8M in Q3 2025); 9-month net loss $469.5M. Pipeline update: oral VK2735 SUNRISE Phase 3 program initiated; subcutaneous VANQUISH 1/2 Phase 3 trials continuing on track, expected completion 2027; VK3019 (amylin agonist) Phase 1 single-ascending-dose study nearing completion, 28-day multiple-ascending-dose study expected to start Q1 2027.

Viking Therapeutics announced it will report Q3 2026 results after market close on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, with a conference call at 4:30pm ET

Viking announces positive topline results from VK2735 maintenance-dosing study: 22% placebo-adjusted weight loss at week 33 (no plateau observed); patients switching from weekly to every-other-week dosing retained up to 97% of prior weight loss, and up to 90% with monthly dosing (vs ~61% retention on placebo); GI side effects during maintenance similar to placebo
catalysts.impact: Stock surged intraday; reported magnitude ranges +27% to +39% depending on source/timing (see conflicts)

catalysts.headline: Truist Securities called the VK2735 maintenance readout a 'best case scenario'; Oppenheimer raised price target to $120 from $100 (Outperform)

Viking filed Form S-3ASR shelf registration enabling future capital raises to fund VK2735 subcutaneous and oral Phase 3 programs; company also completed a ~$159.6M follow-on equity raise around this period
catalysts.impact: dilutive financing event; extends balance sheet
